Serving Omaha Metro

Whether you're prepping a lot for construction, cleaning up an overgrown property, or reclaiming a backyard that's been taken over by brush and volunteer trees, land clearing is the first step.

A1 Junk Removal and Tree Service handles land clearing across the Omaha metro area. We remove trees, grind stumps, chip brush, and haul away everything that needs to go. When we're done, you've got a clean, usable piece of ground.

What We Clear

Residential Lots

Overgrown backyards, side lots, and vacant residential properties. We clear out the trees, brush, and debris so you can use the space again — whether that's for a garden, a fence, or just a clean yard.

Construction Prep

Clearing trees and brush for new construction, additions, or outbuildings. We work with contractors and homeowners to get the site ready for the next phase.

Overgrown Properties

Properties that haven't been maintained in years — thick brush, volunteer trees, vines, and undergrowth. We cut it all down, chip it, and haul it out.

Fence Line Clearing

Trees and brush growing along fence lines that need to be cleared for new fencing, property line maintenance, or just to clean things up.

Photo coming soon

How We Work

Every clearing job starts with a walk-through. We look at what needs to come out, what you want to keep, and how we're going to access the area. Then we put together a plan and a price.

For smaller residential jobs, we can usually get it done in a day. Larger properties or heavily wooded lots may take a few days. We use chainsaws, a commercial brush chipper, and a stump grinder to handle everything on-site. All debris gets chipped or hauled away — we don't leave piles for you to deal with.

Stumps Included

When we clear a property, we don't just cut the trees and leave stumps everywhere. Stump grinding is part of the process. Every stump gets ground below grade so the land is actually usable when we're done — not a minefield of trip hazards.

If you've got an overgrown property that needs to be brought back to life, or a lot that needs to be prepped for building, give us a call. We'll walk it with you, give you an honest price, and get it done.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does land clearing cost?

It depends on the size of the area, the number and size of trees, and how dense the brush is. Small residential lots are less than larger wooded properties. We give free on-site estimates so you know exactly what to expect.

Do you handle permits for land clearing?

In most cases, residential land clearing on private property doesn't require a permit in the Omaha area. If your project does require one, we can help you figure out the process. We always recommend checking with the city before major clearing work.

Can you save certain trees and remove others?

Absolutely. We work with you to identify which trees to keep and which to remove. We'll flag the keepers and work around them carefully.

What do you do with all the debris?

Everything gets processed on-site. Trees are cut and hauled. Brush goes through the chipper. Stumps get ground. We leave the property clean and ready for whatever comes next.
